北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云体感 8℃，风大有点凉，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like 8℃ and is windy. A bit chilly, so keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 10℃，记得添件薄外套，保持舒适哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 10℃. A light jacket might be nice to stay comfy!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 10℃，出门多穿一件，别让凉风吹感冒啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 10℃. Wear an extra layer, don't catch a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 27℃，体感温暖，多云天也要注意补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm at 27℃. Stay hydrated even with clouds!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 23℃，风力 3级。别忘了多喝水，注意防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 23℃ with moderate wind. Drink water and protect from sun!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 9℃。气温凉爽，记得添衣别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 9℃. It's cool, remember to add layers!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 9℃。出门戴口罩，注意防护，记得添衣！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze, feels like 9℃. Wear a mask, protect yourself, and stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃。出门备好雨具，早晚添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 11℃. Bring an umbrella and add layers morning/evening!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 12℃，风力 3级。外出注意防风，及时添衣！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 12℃ with moderate wind. Guard against wind and dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 4℃。气温很低，出门一定要穿厚点哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 4℃. It's very cold, so bundle up when going out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 11℃。湿度较高，出门备好雨具，注意保暖！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 11℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 0℃体感 -5℃，非常冷，记得多穿衣服，别冻着！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin, 0℃ but feels like -5℃. It's freezing! Bundle up and stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 3℃，风力 3级，昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 3℃ with wind. Big day-night temp difference, add layers!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，体感 12℃，风力 3级。早晚偏凉，注意添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 12℃ with wind. Cool mornings/evenings, add layers!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 13℃，风力 3级。记得带伞，外出注意保暖！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels like 13℃ with wind. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感 4℃，有点凉，出门注意防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 4℃ and a bit chilly. Guard against wind and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感 7℃，风力 3级，体感较凉，及时增添衣物！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 7℃ with wind. It's cool, so add layers promptly!
